content.text: Digital creators face a critical problem when attempting to sell ebooks: the lack of reliable payment infrastructure. In regions where platforms like Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad are unavailable or heavily restricted, the need for a sovereign solution becomes urgent. This post explores the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-notion-templates-crypto-stripe-9|The Real]]-behind-payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-3|architecture]] of accepting Bitcoin for ebook sales, focusing on the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-alternatives-gumroad-payhip-restricted-11|COREMERCH guide to difference]]s between the conventional platforms and COREMERCH's solution.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-8. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Bitcoin ebook

Gumroad provides a straightforward platform for selling digital products but imposes a hefty 10% fee on each sale. In contrast, NOWPayments operates with a mere 0.5% fee, significantly reducing costs. This means that for every $97 ebook sold, Gumroad takes $9.70, while NOWPayments only takes $0.49. When selling 100 ebooks per month, that fee difference retains an impressive $921 for the creator. Thus, the architecture you choose directly impacts your profitability.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Conventional platforms like PayPal and Gumroad often exclude users from countries suffering from economic instability or regulatory restrictions. This leaves many creators unable to access essential tools for monetization. COREMERCH’s solution, designed specifically for those locked out by conventional systems, enables creators from these regions to establish their own infrastructure for selling ebooks through automated cryptocurrency payments, ensuring accessibility and independence.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Speed is crucial in digital commerce, especially for instant delivery of ebooks. Traditional platforms can introduce delays in payment processing and settlement. In contrast, NOWPayments offers automated on-chain confirmation, ensuring that transactions are verified quickly and efficiently. Additionally, the low transaction fees associated with cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin, especially on networks like BSC or Solana, further reduce costs, allowing creators to retain more of their revenue and serve their customers reliably.
Retain more earnings with only 0.5% fees from NOWPayments.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership of infrastructure is a game changer for digital creators. With COREMERCH, once you deploy your stack, you own everything and can operate without reliance on any external platform. This means no subscriptions, no KYC hurdles, and total control over your digital products. Automated delivery via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script ensures that customers receive their ebooks instantly upon payment confirmation, providing a seamless experience.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The choice between conventional platforms and sovereign solutions hinges on your specific situation. If you reside in a region where traditional payment processors are functional, you may consider them. However, if you face restrictions or high fees, opting for COREMERCH's Complete Builder Kit is a sound decision. This kit includes all necessary blueprints and templates, allowing any creator to establish a fully operational ecommerce stack tailored to their needs.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Instant product delivery ensures customer satisfaction and repeat business.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell my ebooks without platform fees?
By using COREMERCH’s sovereign stacks, you can eliminate platform fees associated with conventional payment processors. NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, ensuring you keep more of your revenue.
What payment methods can I use for my ebook sales?
With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies for your ebook sales. Choose popular options like Bitcoin or stablecoins for seamless transactions.
Is automated delivery possible for my digital products?
Yes, with COREMERCH, you can automate the delivery of your ebooks using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring instant access for your customers upon payment confirmation.
What if I need support after deployment?
COREMERCH offers a 30-day support period after deployment for your chosen stack. You can reach out for assistance with any technical issues or questions you may have.
Can I scale my business using COREMERCH?
Absolutely. The infrastructure provided by COREMERCH is designed for scaling. You can add more products and features as your business grows without being tied to any platform limitations.
